diagnosis: The session deletion endpoint invokes sessionStore.destroy directly with the sid parameter from the URL path. It does not verify whether the session ID belongs to the requesting user or whether the requester is authenticated at all. An attacker who discovers or predicts a victim's session ID (from server logs, referer headers, or error traces) can prematurely invalidate the victim's session.
exploit_request:
DELETE /api/sessions/sess_victim_authenticated_user_0029 HTTP/1.1
Host: portal.webapp.org:8099
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0
